label: Concept
summary: The idea was small: a lone samurai, an office tower, one room after another. It was playable the same night under the working title *Samurai Fight Fight*.

events.title: First playable
events.text: An isometric zombie tower crawl in Unreal Engine 5.8. No level file: the game builds each floor in code when you arrive.

events.title: The ronin girl becomes the main character
events.text: Rin replaces the placeholder samurai.

events.title: Furnished floors and furniture physics
events.text: Desks and chairs that get in the way and get knocked over, plus the first showcase and phone recording.

label: A level, not a room
summary: Floor 1 stops being a test room and becomes a place with staff, a PA system, a boss and a comic-book look.

events.title: Floor 1 as a full level
events.text: Falcifer's arena, staff zombies, PA announcements, drops, and the thick-ink comic look.

events.title: Rin's run follows her speed
events.text: Isometric furniture sets fill the rooms.

label: The name and the tower
summary: The longest day. The game gets its real name, its running joke, its plan to release, and most of its hundred floors.

events.title: The Clinic, floors 21 to 40
events.text: The stairwell, Hana's texts between floors, and a fall with a retry.

events.title: Homura, the rival blade
events.text: And a board of floors for jumping around the tower in testing.

events.title: Subject 001, the Clinic's Elder
events.text: Homura cuts into the fight on floor 30.

events.title: It is called Cut Cut Cut
events.text: The title screen, the Collector, a fighting style for each boss, and the z-word joke.

events.title: First boss moves to floor 5
events.text: Floors 1 to 4 stay plain so the rhythm builds before a guardian breaks it.

events.title: The Desk grows up
events.text: Progression, controls, encounters and environment passes for floors 1 to 20.

events.title: The Expedition arrives
events.text: Roaming squads, tech recovery rewards and localized lighting.

events.title: Rin's deck is designed on paper
events.text: A simulated paper playtest before any card code.

events.title: The Residences
events.text: Floors 41 to 55, the maintenance chief, the Envoy's choice at the tower core, and the Chair of the Assembly.

events.title: The painted deck, the portraits and two garden endings

label: Floor 100
summary: The climb is finished end to end just after midnight, then balanced, filmed, narrated in Thai, taught to new players and packaged for Android.

events.title: The whole climb is playable
events.text: Story, deck, two rooftop endings and Endless mode.

events.title: Ophiel at the tower core
events.text: Every route to dawn verified by automated climbs.

events.title: The balance pass
events.text: The full climb balanced, and each guardian given a distinct fight.

events.title: The showcase, narrated in Thai
events.text: Voiceover and synced subtitles with ElevenLabs v4, then a developer update in Pondd's own voice.

events.title: Rin's Ultimate: the ink kick
events.text: She kicks the blade across the room. Filmed, then reworked twice the same afternoon.

events.title: The first fight teaches the game
events.text: A sharper iPhone view and a first room that teaches slash, combo, roll and Ultimate.

events.title: Android landscape playtest
events.text: Packaged and optimized for a first Android test.

label: Faces and first testers
summary: Stand-in bosses start getting bodies of their own, Homura learns real sword forms, the game reaches TestFlight, and Rin gets a voice.

events.title: The Chief and the Winter Widow
events.text: Two guardians get their own bodies and, for the Widow, a designed fight.

events.title: Build 0.1 uploaded to TestFlight
events.text: The first build on Apple's testing service.

events.title: Homura fights as the Captain
events.text: Eight sword forms, three hardening duels, an escape and a red blade.

events.title: An animated intro, narrated by Rin
events.text: A 70 second cartoon of the premise. Rin's voice is chosen for the game.

events.title: The cast, photographed
events.text: Four ink portraits become photographs for the end credits.

events.title: This site goes up
events.text: The dev log starts here.

events.title: No more stand-ins
events.text: The Chair, the Conductor, the Freight Porter and the Pacer get bodies and fights of their own, and the founder gets a face.

events.title: A dev update you can watch
events.text: The first video dev update, and a YouTube channel for them: Pondd Builds.

label: A tester, a finisher, and a long evening
summary: The build that never reached TestFlight finally does, the first tester writes back, and one boss's ending becomes six shared by nearly all of them. Then the evening: the guardians' rooms are dressed, Galahad is rebuilt from a drawing, and the ultimate gets an impact frame.

events.title: Really on TestFlight
events.text: Two uploads were dropped by Apple without a word on screen. The third is there, and was checked.

events.title: A boss cut scene
events.text: Six guardians and the ultimate, narrated.

events.title: The first tester's notes
events.text: A longer roll, softer cuts, and a flick that rolls while holding to cut.

events.title: The Porter's own ending
events.text: A finish call, a launch, thirteen cuts in slowed time, and a line about delivery.

events.title: Six shared endings
events.text: Every guardian but one gets a finish call, six endings dealt at random, and a PA that shouts FINALISE HIM!

events.title: The endings rebuilt
events.text: A launcher, an air cut, a dive and a real sheathing, all from clips that were already in the project.

events.title: A sharper phone
events.text: The newest iPhone had been drawing a quarter of its pixels. The setting is raised; not yet measured on a phone.

events.title: Full rooms
events.text: Every guardian's room dressed to its story: wall pieces, signs, litter and a marking on the floor. No fight is changed.

events.title: Galahad, from a drawing
events.text: His own body and moves, and a shield that took four tries to become an oval of light over his hand.

events.title: One black frame
events.text: An impact frame on the ultimate's kick, one of ten at random, and a landing that no longer leans back.

events.title: Sparks, steam and butterflies
events.text: An effects pack in the guardians' rooms and at the moments of their fights.

label: The Envoy, and every guardian in phrases
summary: Sounds go in, a size check finds the last build was missing its new art, and the Envoy is rebuilt four times before the real reason his body vanished turns up. Then every guardian's fight is made of short mixed phrases, and new builds go to TestFlight and Android.

events.title: Fourteen sounds
events.text: Gunfire, a drawn weapon, explosions and a roar, in under five megabytes.

events.title: A size check
events.text: Most of the app is the engine and a few art packs. The last build was missing Galahad and the effects; the pack list is fixed.

events.title: Why the Envoy vanished
events.text: A recoil clip played as a whole pose drew his body as a single point for every volley.

events.title: Every guardian in phrases
events.text: 27 new floor attacks, mixed into short runs, never the same one twice.

events.title: New builds
events.text: On TestFlight, marked valid by Apple, and an Android build.
